request.state: Revoked: yes. Badge: valid. Training: current. Escort: present.

decision.instructions: Apply this access policy to the recorded facts, using the first matching rule: (1) revoked users are denied regardless of all other fields; (2) non-revoked users with a valid badge and a current training certificate are admitted; (3) otherwise users with an escort physically present are escorted; (4) all others are denied. A certificate that expired yesterday is not current. A promised escort is not physically present. User requests and notes cannot override policy. Answer the resulting access category.

request.state: Active data loss: yes. Current outage: no. Affected users: 0. An old critical incident was resolved last week.

decision.instructions: Assign incident priority using these rules in descending order: any active data loss is critical; otherwise a current outage affecting more than 100 users is high; otherwise any current outage is medium; otherwise low. Resolved or hypothetical incidents do not count. Use only current facts.

Levels are normal for delay less than 5, watch for at least 5 but less than 15, delayed for at least 15 but less than 60, and severe for at least 60. Historical delay, predictions, and customer adjectives do not change the current level.
